title: 선 그래프 line graph

categories: [ggplot2, base graph, line graph]
---

#### 패키지 Graphics

```{r}
#| collapse: true
plot(ggplot2::economics$date, ggplot2::economics$unemploy, type = "l")
```

#### 패키지 ggplot2

```{r}
#| collapse: true
library(ggplot2)
ggplot(economics, aes(date, unemploy)) + geom_line()
```
